cycle.transportMethod: Conserved inventory; idealized adiabatic field transport; finite generic accumulator restriction

warnings: Generic component parameters and control assumptions; not manufacturer calibrated.
Outdoor metal and retained water/ice share one equilibrium temperature.
Ice sublimation is excluded; retained ice melts or receives deposition.
Dirt uses clear-passage scaling of air flow/air-side conductance; forced fan power is constant without a measured fan curve.

Conserved R32 charge uses three bulk refrigerant cells per coil, shared outdoor/indoor pressures and a finite accumulator restriction; internal geometry and EEV/compressor maps are generic assumptions.
Field lines store actual refrigerant volume but are hydraulically idealized and adiabatic; friction, ambient line heat, elevation, slip and oil are excluded in this formulation.
Superheat is controlled by finite EEV movement; subcooling and exchanged heat emerge from the stored charge, rather than fixed charge multipliers.

Generic inverter control starts at minimum speed, holds 10 s, then accelerates at 0.5 rps/s; pressure/temperature supervision and restart dwell override demand. Stopped discharge predictions are control estimates, not sensor states.
